newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Brahma downgraded to sell.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Brahma downgraded to sell.

text.p: -- Fator Securities said it has downgraded its recommendation on shares of Brazilian beer maker Brahma to sell from hold.
-- It cited Brahma stock's 15-percent premium to the Sao Paulo stock market's Bovespa index.

-- The brokerage also said Brahma's price-earnings multiples of 19.0 and 16.4 and price-cash flow multiples of 12.1 and 10.2 for 1996 and 1997 respectively are higher than most other firms in the Brazilian beverages sector.

-- Moreover, a slowdown in growth of physical sales to between 5 percent and 7 percent a year, after posting 20-percent growth in the 1994-95 period "is a drawback to a higher stock price," Fator said in a report.
-- It said Brahma's third-quarter results were slightly below its forecast, due mostly to lower gross margins and lower financial gains.
-- Brahma's preferred was flat at 610 reais at 1540 local/1240 EST on the Sao Paulo bolsa and its voting common was untraded after closing Tuesday at 620 reais.
